title: Design: A/P Detail with every bucket closed matches the design picture
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, so the Location column and the Location chip show, as in the design picture.
  • Make sure the report has open bills in all five aging buckets on today's date.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with every bucket collapsed.
  • Open the design picture "A/P Aging Detail opens by vendor name" (ar-ap-p1-a-p-aging-detail-opens-by-vendor-name.png) (attached to this case) beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
custom_steps:
1. Compare the title row and the filter row with the picture.
  2. Compare the header row with the picture, left to right.
  3. Compare the bucket rows with the picture, top to bottom.
  4. Compare the Totals row with the picture.
  5. Widen the browser window to 1536 px and look across the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The title "A/P Aging Detail" with the info icon and the "⋯" at the right.
  • Chips "As of: " (blue pill), "Vendor: All vendors" with a truck icon (resting), "Past due: Any" with an hourglass icon (resting), "Location: All locations" (blue pill).

Step 2:

  • A grey chevron pointing right in the top-left header cell, then "Date", "Location", "Transaction Type", "No.", "Vendor Name" with a small up arrow, "Due Date", "Past Due", "Amount", "Open Balance".

Step 3:

  • Five buckets in this order, each with a blue chevron pointing right, its name in bold with its count in brackets, "Total" under Past Due and two bold sums: "91 or more days past due", "61-90 days past due", "31-60 days past due", "1-30 days past due", "Current".

Step 4:

  • "Totals" with the Amount and Open Balance sums, in bold.

Step 5:

  • Nothing overlaps, is cut off or clipped.
  • The layout is the same as at 1440 px.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order), story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header), story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows), story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S1-R5: “A/R Detail and A/P Detail keep their aging buckets in this fixed order: "91 or more days past due", "61-90 days past due", "31-60 days past due", "1-30 days past due", "Current". Inside each bucket, rows open in customer or vendor name order (S1-R2 to S1-R4), ties by document number (S2-R4).”
  • S1-R7: “The column the report opened on is marked as sorted: the name column on the Summaries and Detail reports, the Date column on Collection and Unpaid Invoices.”
  • S4-R1: “The table's top-left header cell holds one chevron button. While any group is expanded it points down, its tooltip (above the button) reads "Collapse all", and a click collapses every group. When every group is collapsed it points right, its tooltip reads "Expand all", and a click expands every group.”
  • S4-R5: “Each group's own expand toggle uses the same chevron: pointing down when open, right when closed. Behavior is unchanged.”
  • S5-R1: “Each report's filter row is the native report filter row of the newer reports (Inventory Value, Sales By Customer), in this order on all six reports: the date chip ("As of: 10/15/2026"), the customer chip on the A/R reports or the vendor chip on the A/P reports, the Past due chip, then the Location chip.”
  • S2-R1, A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices columns: “A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices: Date, Location (when shown), Transaction Type, No., Vendor Name, Due Date, Past Due, Amount, Open Balance.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 1 "Opening order and header sorting" (board Main.dc.html).   • ar-ap-p1-a-p-aging-detail-as-it-opens-today.png: figure "A/P Aging Detail as it opens today" (Production (before)), board "1. Opening order and header sorting" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "Buckets stay in fixed order; rows inside each bucket go by vendor name (was most overdue first). S1-R5, S2-R4, S2-R5." (caption of "A/P Aging Detail opens by vendor name")
  • "Inside a bucket, rows open most overdue first. No sortable headers." (caption of "A/P Aging Detail as it opens today")
